name: Reach The Exit
objective: Learn to walk, jump, and reach the exit.
designNote: A quiet first room introduces the controls with no timer and one obvious route.

name: One Good Push
objective: Move a single box beneath a ledge.
designNote: The box is both a tool and a question: where should it go before you climb?

name: A Little Higher
objective: Stack two blocks to reach a raised doorway.
designNote: A low ceiling makes the order of each push matter.

name: Red Means Go
objective: Hold a floor switch down with a block.
designNote: A red signal light makes the connection between switch and door easy to read.

name: Room to Turn
objective: Recover from a misplaced block and find another route.
designNote: Safe dead ends invite experimentation and make the reset option feel useful.

name: Split Decision
objective: Open two gates by leaving blocks on separate switches.
designNote: The room is symmetrical, but the order of operations is not.

name: The Long Way
objective: Carry a block through a side corridor to the main room.
designNote: A one-way drop asks players to plan where their tools will be needed next.

name: Weight of It
objective: Balance a lift with the player and a movable block.
designNote: A simple two-state lift rewards noticing that the player is part of the puzzle.

name: A Narrow Margin
objective: Slide a block through a narrow passage without trapping it.
designNote: Clear silhouettes show which gaps are traversable before a move is committed.

name: Echo Chamber
objective: Activate a distant gate from the opposite side of the room.
designNote: A repeated visual signal connects a distant switch to its matching gate.

name: No Spare Squares
objective: Place three blocks in a room with no safe storage tiles.
designNote: Every square has a purpose, so the solution comes from undoing assumptions.

name: The False Exit
objective: Find the switch hidden beyond an apparent dead end.
designNote: A visible exit is a clue, not the whole answer; the room rewards looking back.

name: Keep It Moving
objective: Ride a platform while keeping a block in reach.
designNote: Predictable platform timing keeps the challenge in planning rather than reflexes.

name: Outside the Lines
objective: Use the room's platforms to activate switches in sequence.
designNote: Previously learned mechanics combine without adding a new rule.

name: A Box of Your Own
objective: Choose your own route through a multi-step final puzzle.
designNote: Several valid solutions close the concept set with player-led experimentation.
